name: cli-watch should watch world
summary: Watch both world.json (focus changes) and current task file (task updates)

rawActions.name: Understand watch design: dual file monitoring
rawActions.summary: World storage: .nameforma/{entity}/{id}.json (not single world.json). Task files at .nameforma/task/{id}.json. Focus info in world object loaded from worldPath. Study World.fromPath(), world.focusedForma('task'). Understand that focus changes require reloading world. TEST: None needed, architecture study only.

rawActions.name: Refactor WatchCommand.action() to track both files
rawActions.summary: In WatchCommand.action() line 56-120: (1) Track both world.json and task file mtimes: const mtimes = { world: 0, task: 0 }; (2) In watchInterval (500ms), stat both files; (3) If world.json changed: reload via World.fromPath(worldPath), get new focus via world.focusedForma('task'), check if focus changed; (4) If task file changed: reload task via world.loadEntity(Task, id), display. TEST: Create /tmp/.nameforma world with test task files. Run watch against /tmp, verify both files' mtime tracked independently.

rawActions.name: Detect focus changes from world.json
rawActions.summary: In watchInterval when world.json changes: (1) Reload world = World.fromPath(worldPath); (2) Get newFocus = world.focusedForma('task'); (3) If newFocus.formaId !== oldTaskId: switch watchers - update taskFilePath to .nameforma/task/{newFocus.formaId.base64}.json, reset taskMtime, reload reloadedTask = world.loadEntity(Task, newFocus.formaId), display new task. Handle gracefully if newFocus is null. TEST: Create /tmp world with 2 test tasks. Start watch on task A. Modify /tmp/.nameforma/world.json focusStack to add new Focus for task B. Verify watch switches to task B and displays it.

rawActions.name: Update cleanup logic for dual watchers
rawActions.summary: Store watchInterval ID. In cleanup function: clearInterval(watchInterval). Ensure called on SIGINT, 'q'/'Q' key, ESC (code 27). TEST: Create /tmp world. Run watch against /tmp, send SIGINT/press q key. Verify clean exit: no error, no orphaned watch process. Run multiple times to verify no accumulating intervals.
